destination_poi.description_summer: Bettmerhorn is part of a long ridge between Laxeralp and Grosser Aletschgletscher. The eastern summit has a big metal cross, while the highest point is crowned by a simple cairn. Bettmerhorn offers a rewarding traverse on the ridge between the Bettmergrat station and Eggishorn.

segments.description: Eggishorn is reached without difficulty on a marked mountain hiking trail. The summit resembles a balcony jutting out above Grosser Aletschgletscher.
segments.title: Eggishorn station – Eggishorn

segments.description: Descend to the Eggishorn station on the ascent route. The continuation towards Bettmerhorn begins with a descent on ski runs until Elselicka.
segments.title: Eggishorn – Elselicka

segments.description: The pathless itinerary on scree and boulders is marked white-blue-white. From Elselicka it follows more or less the ridge line. Several exposed and precarious passages are equipped with steel cables and steps. At P. 2871 the highest elevation on Bettmergrat is traversed. Bettmerhorn itself is a few metres lower. The descent from Bettmerhorn to the Bettmerhorn summit station is equipped with ladders and steel cables.
segments.title: Elselicka – Bettmerhorn –Bettmerhorn station

segments.description: The tour can be ended at the Bettmerhorn station. However, a mountain hiking trail with a wonderful view continues on the ridge. Via Hohbalm continue to hike until P. 2288 shortly before Biel. There leave the ridge to descend to Bettmersee and go on to reach Bettmeralp in a few minutes.
segments.title: Bettmerhorn station – Bettmeralp

segments.description: Instead of descending towards Bettmeralp at Biel, continue on the ridge to Moosfluh (summit station of a gondola), Hohfluh and finally Riederfurka (restaurant). From here hike down to Riederalp. The aerial cable way brings you down to Mörel, from where you reach the railway station within five minutes. Bettmerhorn station – Riederfurka – Riederalp 2 h.
segments.title: Descent variant on the entire Bettmergrat

segments.description: From the Bettmerhorn station hike around the west side of Bettmerhorn and Eggishorn to reach Märjelesee and Gletscherstube. Through a tunnel below Tälligrat (flashlight helpful) you gain Obers Tälli. Back to Fiescheralp (gondola). Bettmerhorn station – Märjelensee – Fiescheralp 3 h.
segments.title: Alternative descent via Märjelensee

teaser: The tour is mountain hiking at its best. On Bettmergrat you can feel the cool breeze coming off Aletschgletscher, the centrepiece of the Unesco World Heritage Site whose border we walk on.
teaser_title: This is a hike with a view on a ridge above Grosser Aletschgletscher
title: Traverse Eggishorn – Bettmerhorn

reference_poi.description_summer: An oft-visited, excellent and famous vantage point high above the Aletsch Glacier. Cable car station to the south at 2869 m. NW and NE ridges offer some interesting scrambling.

reference_poi.description_summer: Breite Einsattelung zwischen Bettmer- und Eggishorn. Als Übergang ohne Bedeutung. Von Südosten und vom Eggishorn leicht zu  erreichen.

description.description:
Total hiking time 4 Std.
Eggishorn station – Eggishorn –Eggishorn station ½ h
Eggishorn station – Elselicka – Bettmerhorn –Bettmergrat station 2 h 
Bettmergrat station – Hohbalm – P. 2288 – Bettmeralp (summit station of the aerial cableway) 1½ h

The itinerary is marked. Several precarious passages are equipped with steel cables, steps and ladders (without being a via ferrata; so special gear is not required). The hike on the ridge is fairly long and offers no possibility to cut it short. Not to be undertaken in instable weather.
